verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party Masked Email help article and an aliases setup article. Independent users confirm they use masked emails for throwaway or sketchy sites, that the feature needs only Fastmail (it is an option in settings), and that subdomain addressing works where plus addresses get rejected. Missing for 10: first-party doc content (only article titles are in evidence) describing how masked addresses hide the real address on sends and replies, and documented management controls (disable/delete/block) for masked addresses.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address

citations.quote: Masked emails have been so nice for throwaway/sketchy sites.
was delighted that only Fastmail is required; it's an option in settings.
Subdomain addressing is a killer feature: foo@bar.mydomain.com always works where plus/dot addresses get rejected.
